"""
Complete DCF financial model built with the creating-financial-models skill.

Valuation of "NovaTech Systems" - a hypothetical high-growth software company.
Includes: WACC build-up, 5-year cash flow projection, terminal value,
enterprise/equity valuation, two-way sensitivity table, and scenario analysis.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Make the skill's DCF engine importable
SKILL_DIR = Path(".codex/skills/creating-financial-models").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(SKILL_DIR))

import numpy as np
from dcf_model import DCFModel

OUT = []


def section(title: str) -> None:
    OUT.append("")
    OUT.append("=" * 66)
    OUT.append(f"  {title}")
    OUT.append("=" * 66)


def line(txt: str = "") -> None:
    OUT.append(txt)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build the model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model = DCFModel("NovaTech Systems")

model.set_historical_financials(
    revenue=[820, 940, 1080, 1240, 1420],          # $M
    ebitda=[150, 180, 218, 260, 308],              # $M
    capex=[45, 50, 55, 62, 70],                    # $M
    nwc=[85, 96, 110, 125, 142],                   # $M
    years=[2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025],
)

model.set_assumptions(
    projection_years=5,
    revenue_growth=[0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08],
    ebitda_margin=[0.22, 0.23, 0.24, 0.25, 0.26],
    tax_rate=0.25,
    capex_percent=[0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05],
    nwc_percent=[0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10],
    terminal_growth=0.03,
)

wacc = model.calculate_wacc(
    risk_free_rate=0.042,   # 10-yr treasury
    beta=1.25,
    market_premium=0.055,
    cost_of_debt=0.045,
    debt_to_equity=0.30,
)

model.project_cash_flows()
model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Report: WACC build-up
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("1. WACC BUILD-UP (Weighted Average Cost of Capital)")
w = model.wacc_components
line(f"  Risk-free rate (10-yr Treasury):        {w['risk_free_rate']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Equity beta:                            {w['beta']:6.2f}")
line(f"  Equity market risk premium:             {w['market_premium']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Cost of equity (CAPM):                  {w['cost_of_equity']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Pre-tax cost of debt:                   {w['cost_of_debt']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Tax rate:                               {w['tax_rate']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Debt / (Debt + Equity) weight:          {w['debt_weight']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Equity weight:                          {w['equity_weight']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  >> WACC = {w['wacc']*100:.2f}%")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Report: Cash flow projection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("2. 5-YEAR CASH FLOW PROJECTION ($M)")
p = model.projections
hdr = f"  {'Year':<6}{'Revenue':>10}{'EBITDA':>10}{'EBIT':>10}{'NOPAT':>10}{'Capex':>9}{'NWC Δ':>9}{'FCF':>10}"
line(hdr)
line("  " + "-" * 66)
for i in range(len(p["year"])):
    line(
        f"  Y{i+1:<5}{p['revenue'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['ebitda'][i]:>10,.0f}"
        f"{p['ebit'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['nopat'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['capex'][i]:>9,.0f}"
        f"{p['nwc_change'][i]:>9,.0f}{p['fcf'][i]:>10,.0f}"
    )
fcf_cagr = (p["fcf"][-1] / p["fcf"][0]) ** (1 / 4) - 1
line(f"\n  Projected FCF CAGR (Y1->Y5): {fcf_cagr*100:.1f}%")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Report: Valuation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("3. VALUATION RESULTS")
v = model.valuation_results
line(f"  PV of projected FCF (5 yrs):        ${v['pv_fcf']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Terminal value (Gordon growth):      ${v['terminal_value']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  PV of terminal value:                ${v['pv_terminal']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Terminal value % of enterprise:      {v['terminal_percent']:>9.1f}%")
line(f"  >> Enterprise Value:                 ${v['enterprise_value']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Less: Net debt:                      ${v['net_debt']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Plus: Cash:                          ${v['cash']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  >> Equity Value:                     ${v['equity_value']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Shares outstanding:                  {v['shares_outstanding']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  >> Value per share:                  ${v['value_per_share']:>10,.2f}")

# Implied multiples
implied_ev_ebitda = v["enterprise_value"] / p["ebitda"][-1]
line(f"\n  Implied EV / 2029E EBITDA:          {implied_ev_ebitda:>10.1f}x")
line(f"  Implied EV / 2029E Revenue:          {v['enterprise_value'] / p['revenue'][-1]:>10.1f}x")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Two-way sensitivity: WACC x terminal growth on value per share
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("4. SENSITIVITY: VALUE PER SHARE ($) vs WACC and TERMINAL GROWTH")

wacc_grid = [0.085, 0.095, 0.105, 0.115, 0.125, 0.135]
growth_grid = [0.020, 0.025, 0.030, 0.035, 0.040]

orig_wacc = model.wacc_components["wacc"]
orig_tg = model.assumptions["terminal_growth"]

grid = np.zeros((len(wacc_grid), len(growth_grid)))
for i, wv in enumerate(wacc_grid):
    for j, gv in enumerate(growth_grid):
        model.wacc_components["wacc"] = wv
        model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = gv
        model.project_cash_flows()
        model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
        model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)
        grid[i, j] = model.valuation_results["value_per_share"]

# Restore base
model.wacc_components["wacc"] = orig_wacc
model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = orig_tg
model.project_cash_flows()
model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)

line(f"  Rows = WACC, Columns = Terminal growth")
line(f"  {'WACC\\Growth':<12}" + "".join(f"{g*100:>10.1f}%" for g in growth_grid))
for i, wv in enumerate(wacc_grid):
    line(f"  {wv*100:<11.2f}%" + "".join(f"{grid[i, j]:>10.2f}" for j in range(len(growth_grid))))

base_vps = model.valuation_results["value_per_share"]
min_vps = grid.min()
max_vps = grid.max()
line(f"\n  Base-case value per share: ${base_vps:.2f}")
line(f"  Sensitivity range: ${min_vps:.2f} to ${max_vps:.2f} "
     f"({(max_vps - base_vps) / base_vps * 100:+.1f}% / {(min_vps - base_vps) / base_vps * 100:+.1f}%)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Scenario analysis (Best / Base / Worst)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("5. SCENARIO ANALYSIS")

scenarios = {
    "Best Case":  {"growth": 0.20, "margin": 0.28, "wacc": 0.095, "prob": 0.25},
    "Base Case":  {"growth": 0.12, "margin": 0.24, "wacc": 0.105, "prob": 0.50},
    "Worst Case": {"growth": 0.06, "margin": 0.19, "wacc": 0.125, "prob": 0.25},
}

exp_val = 0.0
line(f"  {'Scenario':<12}{'Rev Growth':>11}{'EBITDA %':>10}{'WACC':>8}{'Prob':>7}{'Value/Shr':>11}{'Weighted':>11}")
line("  " + "-" * 66)
for name, s in scenarios.items():
    model.wacc_components["wacc"] = s["wacc"]
    model.assumptions["revenue_growth"] = [s["growth"]] * 5
    model.assumptions["ebitda_margin"] = [s["margin"]] * 5
    model.project_cash_flows()
    model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
    model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)
    vps = model.valuation_results["value_per_share"]
    weighted = vps * s["prob"]
    exp_val += weighted
    line(
        f"  {name:<12}{s['growth']*100:>10.1f}%{s['margin']*100:>10.1f}%"
        f"{s['wacc']*100:>7.2f}%{s['prob']*100:>6.0f}%${vps:>10.2f}${weighted:>10.2f}"
    )
line(f"\n  Probability-weighted expected value per share: ${exp_val:.2f}")

# Restore base
model.wacc_components["wacc"] = orig_wacc
model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = orig_tg
model.assumptions["revenue_growth"] = [0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08]
model.assumptions["ebitda_margin"] = [0.22, 0.23, 0.24, 0.25, 0.26]
model.project_cash_flows()
model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Final summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("6. MODEL SUMMARY")
line(model.generate_summary())

# Quality check: PV of FCF + PV of terminal == EV
check = abs(v["pv_fcf"] + v["pv_terminal"] - v["enterprise_value"]) < 1e-6
line(f"\n  Quality check (PV FCF + PV TV == EV): {'PASS' if check else 'FAIL'}")

print("\n".join(OUT))

"""
Complete DCF financial model built with the creating-financial-models skill
methodology (pure-Python implementation, no external dependencies).

Valuation of "NovaTech Systems" - a hypothetical high-growth software company.
Includes: WACC build-up, 5-year cash flow projection, terminal value,
enterprise/equity valuation, two-way sensitivity table, and scenario analysis.
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DCF engine (implements the skill's DCFModel methodology in pure Python)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class DCFEngine:
    """Pure-Python DCF valuation engine."""

    def __init__(self, company_name="Company"):
        self.company_name = company_name
        self.historical = {}
        self.assumptions = {}
        self.wacc = None
        self.projections = {}
        self.valuation = {}

    # -- inputs -------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_historical(self, revenue, ebitda, capex, nwc, years):
        self.historical = {
            "years": years,
            "revenue": revenue,
            "ebitda": ebitda,
            "ebitda_margin": [ebitda[i] / revenue[i] for i in range(len(revenue))],
            "capex_percent": [capex[i] / revenue[i] for i in range(len(revenue))],
        }

    def set_assumptions(self, projection_years, revenue_growth, ebitda_margin,
                        tax_rate, capex_percent, nwc_percent, terminal_growth):
        self.assumptions = {
            "projection_years": projection_years,
            "revenue_growth": revenue_growth,
            "ebitda_margin": ebitda_margin,
            "tax_rate": tax_rate,
            "capex_percent": capex_percent,
            "nwc_percent": nwc_percent,
            "terminal_growth": terminal_growth,
        }

    # -- WACC ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def calc_wacc(self, risk_free_rate, beta, market_premium, cost_of_debt,
                  debt_to_equity, tax_rate=None):
        if tax_rate is None:
            tax_rate = self.assumptions["tax_rate"]
        cost_of_equity = risk_free_rate + beta * market_premium
        equity_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + debt_to_equity)
        debt_weight = debt_to_equity / (1.0 + debt_to_equity)
        self.wacc = (
            equity_weight * cost_of_equity
            + debt_weight * cost_of_debt * (1 - tax_rate)
        )
        self.wacc_components = {
            "risk_free_rate": risk_free_rate, "beta": beta,
            "market_premium": market_premium, "cost_of_equity": cost_of_equity,
            "cost_of_debt": cost_of_debt, "debt_to_equity": debt_to_equity,
            "equity_weight": equity_weight, "debt_weight": debt_weight,
            "tax_rate": tax_rate, "wacc": self.wacc,
        }
        return self.wacc

    # -- projection ---------------------------------------------------------
    def project(self):
        yrs = self.assumptions["projection_years"]
        base_rev = self.historical["revenue"][-1]
        prev_rev, prev_nwc = base_rev, base_rev * self.assumptions["nwc_percent"][0]

        proj = {"year": [], "revenue": [], "ebitda": [], "ebit": [], "nopat": [],
                "capex": [], "nwc_change": [], "fcf": []}
        for i in range(yrs):
            rev = prev_rev * (1 + self.assumptions["revenue_growth"][i])
            ebitda = rev * self.assumptions["ebitda_margin"][i]
            dep = rev * self.assumptions["capex_percent"][i]   # D&A ≈ capex
            ebit = ebitda - dep
            tax = ebit * self.assumptions["tax_rate"]
            nopat = ebit - tax
            capex = dep
            nwc = rev * self.assumptions["nwc_percent"][i]
            d_nwc = nwc - prev_nwc
            fcf = nopat + dep - capex - d_nwc

            proj["year"].append(i + 1)
            proj["revenue"].append(rev); proj["ebitda"].append(ebitda)
            proj["ebit"].append(ebit); proj["nopat"].append(nopat)
            proj["capex"].append(capex); proj["nwc_change"].append(d_nwc)
            proj["fcf"].append(fcf)
            prev_rev, prev_nwc = rev, nwc

        self.projections = proj
        return proj

    # -- valuation ----------------------------------------------------------
    def value(self, exit_multiple=None):
        yrs = self.assumptions["projection_years"]
        wacc = self.wacc
        pv_fcf = [fcf / (1 + wacc) ** (i + 1) for i, fcf in enumerate(self.projections["fcf"])]
        total_pv_fcf = sum(pv_fcf)

        if exit_multiple is None:
            tv = (self.projections["fcf"][-1] * (1 + self.assumptions["terminal_growth"])
                  / (wacc - self.assumptions["terminal_growth"]))
            method = "Gordon growth"
        else:
            tv = self.projections["ebitda"][-1] * exit_multiple
            method = "exit multiple"

        pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** yrs
        ev = total_pv_fcf + pv_tv
        self.valuation = {
            "pv_fcf": total_pv_fcf, "terminal_value": tv, "pv_terminal": pv_tv,
            "enterprise_value": ev, "terminal_percent": pv_tv / ev * 100,
            "method": method, "pv_fcf_detail": pv_fcf,
        }
        return self.valuation

    def equity(self, net_debt, cash, shares):
        ev = self.valuation["enterprise_value"]
        eq = ev - net_debt + cash
        self.valuation.update({
            "equity_value": eq, "net_debt": net_debt, "cash": cash,
            "shares": shares, "value_per_share": eq / shares,
        })
        return self.valuation


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model = DCFEngine("NovaTech Systems")
model.set_historical(
    revenue=[820, 940, 1080, 1240, 1420],     # $M (2021-2025)
    ebitda=[150, 180, 218, 260, 308],         # $M
    capex=[45, 50, 55, 62, 70],               # $M
    nwc=[85, 96, 110, 125, 142],              # $M
    years=[2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025],
)
model.set_assumptions(
    projection_years=5,
    revenue_growth=[0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08],
    ebitda_margin=[0.22, 0.23, 0.24, 0.25, 0.26],
    tax_rate=0.25,
    capex_percent=[0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05],
    nwc_percent=[0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10],
    terminal_growth=0.03,
)
model.calc_wacc(risk_free_rate=0.042, beta=1.25, market_premium=0.055,
                cost_of_debt=0.045, debt_to_equity=0.30)
model.project()
model.value()
model.equity(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares=120)

OUT = []
def section(t): OUT.append("\n" + "=" * 66 + f"\n  {t}\n" + "=" * 66)
def line(t=""): OUT.append(t)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("1. WACC BUILD-UP (Weighted Average Cost of Capital)")
w = model.wacc_components
for k, fmt in [("risk_free_rate", "Risk-free rate (10-yr Treasury):      {:6.2f}%"),
               ("beta", "Equity beta:                           {:6.2f}"),
               ("market_premium", "Equity market risk premium:              {:6.2f}%"),
               ("cost_of_equity", "Cost of equity (CAPM):                   {:6.2f}%"),
               ("cost_of_debt", "Pre-tax cost of debt:                    {:6.2f}%"),
               ("tax_rate", "Tax rate:                                {:6.2f}%"),
               ("debt_weight", "Debt weight:                             {:6.2f}%"),
               ("equity_weight", "Equity weight:                           {:6.2f}%")]:
    val = w[k] * 100 if k != "beta" else w[k]
    line(f"  {fmt.format(val)}")
line(f"  >> WACC = {w['wacc']*100:.2f}%")

section("2. 5-YEAR CASH FLOW PROJECTION ($M)")
p = model.projections
line(f"  {'Year':<6}{'Revenue':>10}{'EBITDA':>10}{'EBIT':>10}{'NOPAT':>10}{'Capex':>9}{'NWC Δ':>9}{'FCF':>10}")
line("  " + "-" * 66)
for i in range(len(p["year"])):
    line(f"  Y{p['year'][i]:<5}{p['revenue'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['ebitda'][i]:>10,.0f}"
         f"{p['ebit'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['nopat'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['capex'][i]:>9,.0f}"
         f"{p['nwc_change'][i]:>9,.0f}{p['fcf'][i]:>10,.0f}")
cagr = (p["fcf"][-1] / p["fcf"][0]) ** (1 / 4) - 1
line(f"\n  Projected FCF CAGR (Y1 -> Y5): {cagr*100:.1f}%")

section("3. VALUATION RESULTS")
v = model.valuation

line("  Rows = WACC | Columns = Terminal growth")

base_vps = model.valuation["value_per_share"]
vals = [x for row in grid for x in row]
line(f"\n  Base-case value per share: ${base_vps:.2f}")
line(f"  Sensitivity range: ${min(vals):.2f} to ${max(vals):.2f} "
     f"({(max(vals)-base_vps)/base_vps*100:+.1f}% / {(min(vals)-base_vps)/base_vps*100:+.1f}%)")

section("5. SCENARIO ANALYSIS (Best / Base / Worst)")
scenarios = [

line("  " + "-" * 66)

"""
Complete DCF financial model built with the creating-financial-models skill.

Valuation of "NovaTech Systems" - a hypothetical high-growth software company.
Includes: WACC build-up, 5-year cash flow projection, terminal value,
enterprise/equity valuation, two-way sensitivity table, and scenario analysis.

import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Make the skill's DCF engine importable
SKILL_DIR = Path(".codex/skills/creating-financial-models").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(SKILL_DIR))

import numpy as np
from dcf_model import DCFModel

OUT = []


def section(title: str) -> None:
    OUT.append("")
    OUT.append("=" * 66)
    OUT.append(f"  {title}")
    OUT.append("=" * 66)


def line(txt: str = "") -> None:
    OUT.append(txt)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build the model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model = DCFModel("NovaTech Systems")

model.set_historical_financials(
    revenue=[820, 940, 1080, 1240, 1420],          # $M
    ebitda=[150, 180, 218, 260, 308],              # $M
    capex=[45, 50, 55, 62, 70],                    # $M
    nwc=[85, 96, 110, 125, 142],                   # $M
    years=[2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025],
)

model.set_assumptions(
    projection_years=5,
    revenue_growth=[0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08],
    ebitda_margin=[0.22, 0.23, 0.24, 0.25, 0.26],
    tax_rate=0.25,
    capex_percent=[0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05],
    nwc_percent=[0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10],
    terminal_growth=0.03,
)

wacc = model.calculate_wacc(
    risk_free_rate=0.042,   # 10-yr treasury
    beta=1.25,
    market_premium=0.055,
    cost_of_debt=0.045,
    debt_to_equity=0.30,
)

model.project_cash_flows()
model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Report: WACC build-up
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("1. WACC BUILD-UP (Weighted Average Cost of Capital)")
w = model.wacc_components
line(f"  Risk-free rate (10-yr Treasury):        {w['risk_free_rate']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Equity beta:                            {w['beta']:6.2f}")
line(f"  Equity market risk premium:             {w['market_premium']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Cost of equity (CAPM):                  {w['cost_of_equity']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Pre-tax cost of debt:                   {w['cost_of_debt']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Tax rate:                               {w['tax_rate']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Debt / (Debt + Equity) weight:          {w['debt_weight']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  Equity weight:                          {w['equity_weight']*100:6.2f}%")
line(f"  >> WACC = {w['wacc']*100:.2f}%")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Report: Cash flow projection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("2. 5-YEAR CASH FLOW PROJECTION ($M)")
p = model.projections
hdr = f"  {'Year':<6}{'Revenue':>10}{'EBITDA':>10}{'EBIT':>10}{'NOPAT':>10}{'Capex':>9}{'NWC Δ':>9}{'FCF':>10}"
line(hdr)
line("  " + "-" * 66)
for i in range(len(p["year"])):
    line(
        f"  Y{i+1:<5}{p['revenue'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['ebitda'][i]:>10,.0f}"
        f"{p['ebit'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['nopat'][i]:>10,.0f}{p['capex'][i]:>9,.0f}"
        f"{p['nwc_change'][i]:>9,.0f}{p['fcf'][i]:>10,.0f}"
    )
fcf_cagr = (p["fcf"][-1] / p["fcf"][0]) ** (1 / 4) - 1
line(f"\n  Projected FCF CAGR (Y1->Y5): {fcf_cagr*100:.1f}%")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Report: Valuation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("3. VALUATION RESULTS")
v = model.valuation_results
line(f"  PV of projected FCF (5 yrs):        ${v['pv_fcf']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Terminal value (Gordon growth):      ${v['terminal_value']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  PV of terminal value:                ${v['pv_terminal']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Terminal value % of enterprise:      {v['terminal_percent']:>9.1f}%")
line(f"  >> Enterprise Value:                 ${v['enterprise_value']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Less: Net debt:                      ${v['net_debt']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Plus: Cash:                          ${v['cash']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  >> Equity Value:                     ${v['equity_value']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  Shares outstanding:                  {v['shares_outstanding']:>10,.0f}M")
line(f"  >> Value per share:                  ${v['value_per_share']:>10,.2f}")

# Implied multiples
implied_ev_ebitda = v["enterprise_value"] / p["ebitda"][-1]
line(f"\n  Implied EV / 2029E EBITDA:          {implied_ev_ebitda:>10.1f}x")
line(f"  Implied EV / 2029E Revenue:          {v['enterprise_value'] / p['revenue'][-1]:>10.1f}x")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Two-way sensitivity: WACC x terminal growth on value per share
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("4. SENSITIVITY: VALUE PER SHARE ($) vs WACC and TERMINAL GROWTH")

wacc_grid = [0.085, 0.095, 0.105, 0.115, 0.125, 0.135]
growth_grid = [0.020, 0.025, 0.030, 0.035, 0.040]

orig_wacc = model.wacc_components["wacc"]
orig_tg = model.assumptions["terminal_growth"]

grid = np.zeros((len(wacc_grid), len(growth_grid)))
for i, wv in enumerate(wacc_grid):
    for j, gv in enumerate(growth_grid):
        model.wacc_components["wacc"] = wv
        model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = gv
        model.project_cash_flows()
        model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
        model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)
        grid[i, j] = model.valuation_results["value_per_share"]

# Restore base
model.wacc_components["wacc"] = orig_wacc
model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = orig_tg
model.project_cash_flows()
model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)

line(f"  Rows = WACC, Columns = Terminal growth")
line(f"  {'WACC\\Growth':<12}" + "".join(f"{g*100:>10.1f}%" for g in growth_grid))
for i, wv in enumerate(wacc_grid):
    line(f"  {wv*100:<11.2f}%" + "".join(f"{grid[i, j]:>10.2f}" for j in range(len(growth_grid))))

base_vps = model.valuation_results["value_per_share"]
min_vps = grid.min()
max_vps = grid.max()
line(f"\n  Base-case value per share: ${base_vps:.2f}")
line(f"  Sensitivity range: ${min_vps:.2f} to ${max_vps:.2f} "
     f"({(max_vps - base_vps) / base_vps * 100:+.1f}% / {(min_vps - base_vps) / base_vps * 100:+.1f}%)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Scenario analysis (Best / Base / Worst)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("5. SCENARIO ANALYSIS")

scenarios = {
    "Best Case":  {"growth": 0.20, "margin": 0.28, "wacc": 0.095, "prob": 0.25},
    "Base Case":  {"growth": 0.12, "margin": 0.24, "wacc": 0.105, "prob": 0.50},
    "Worst Case": {"growth": 0.06, "margin": 0.19, "wacc": 0.125, "prob": 0.25},
}

exp_val = 0.0
line(f"  {'Scenario':<12}{'Rev Growth':>11}{'EBITDA %':>10}{'WACC':>8}{'Prob':>7}{'Value/Shr':>11}{'Weighted':>11}")
line("  " + "-" * 66)
for name, s in scenarios.items():
    model.wacc_components["wacc"] = s["wacc"]
    model.assumptions["revenue_growth"] = [s["growth"]] * 5
    model.assumptions["ebitda_margin"] = [s["margin"]] * 5
    model.project_cash_flows()
    model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
    model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)
    vps = model.valuation_results["value_per_share"]
    weighted = vps * s["prob"]
    exp_val += weighted
    line(
        f"  {name:<12}{s['growth']*100:>10.1f}%{s['margin']*100:>10.1f}%"
        f"{s['wacc']*100:>7.2f}%{s['prob']*100:>6.0f}%${vps:>10.2f}${weighted:>10.2f}"
    )
line(f"\n  Probability-weighted expected value per share: ${exp_val:.2f}")

# Restore base
model.wacc_components["wacc"] = orig_wacc
model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = orig_tg
model.assumptions["revenue_growth"] = [0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08]
model.assumptions["ebitda_margin"] = [0.22, 0.23, 0.24, 0.25, 0.26]
model.project_cash_flows()
model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares_outstanding=120)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Final summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("6. MODEL SUMMARY")
line(model.generate_summary())

# Quality check: PV of FCF + PV of terminal == EV
check = abs(v["pv_fcf"] + v["pv_terminal"] - v["enterprise_value"]) < 1e-6
line(f"\n  Quality check (PV FCF + PV TV == EV): {'PASS' if check else 'FAIL'}")

print("\n".join(OUT))

"""
Complete DCF financial model built with the creating-financial-models skill
methodology (pure-Python implementation, no external dependencies).

Valuation of "NovaTech Systems" - a hypothetical high-growth software company.
Includes: WACC build-up, 5-year cash flow projection, terminal value,
enterprise/equity valuation, two-way sensitivity table, and scenario analysis.
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DCF engine (implements the skill's DCFModel methodology in pure Python)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class DCFEngine:
    """Pure-Python DCF valuation engine."""

    def __init__(self, company_name="Company"):
        self.company_name = company_name
        self.historical = {}
        self.assumptions = {}
        self.wacc = None
        self.projections = {}
        self.valuation = {}

    # -- inputs -------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_historical(self, revenue, ebitda, capex, nwc, years):
        self.historical = {
            "years": years,
            "revenue": revenue,
            "ebitda": ebitda,
            "ebitda_margin": [ebitda[i] / revenue[i] for i in range(len(revenue))],
            "capex_percent": [capex[i] / revenue[i] for i in range(len(revenue))],
        }

    def set_assumptions(self, projection_years, revenue_growth, ebitda_margin,
                        tax_rate, capex_percent, nwc_percent, terminal_growth):
        self.assumptions = {
            "projection_years": projection_years,
            "revenue_growth": revenue_growth,
            "ebitda_margin": ebitda_margin,
            "tax_rate": tax_rate,
            "capex_percent": capex_percent,
            "nwc_percent": nwc_percent,
            "terminal_growth": terminal_growth,
        }

    # -- WACC ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def calc_wacc(self, risk_free_rate, beta, market_premium, cost_of_debt,
                  debt_to_equity, tax_rate=None):
        if tax_rate is None:
            tax_rate = self.assumptions["tax_rate"]
        cost_of_equity = risk_free_rate + beta * market_premium
        equity_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + debt_to_equity)
        debt_weight = debt_to_equity / (1.0 + debt_to_equity)
        self.wacc = (
            equity_weight * cost_of_equity
            + debt_weight * cost_of_debt * (1 - tax_rate)
        )
        self.wacc_components = {
            "risk_free_rate": risk_free_rate, "beta": beta,
            "market_premium": market_premium, "cost_of_equity": cost_of_equity,
            "cost_of_debt": cost_of_debt, "debt_to_equity": debt_to_equity,
            "equity_weight": equity_weight, "debt_weight": debt_weight,
            "tax_rate": tax_rate, "wacc": self.wacc,
        }
        return self.wacc

    # -- projection ---------------------------------------------------------
    def project(self):
        yrs = self.assumptions["projection_years"]
        base_rev = self.historical["revenue"][-1]
        prev_rev, prev_nwc = base_rev, base_rev * self.assumptions["nwc_percent"][0]

        proj = {"year": [], "revenue": [], "ebitda": [], "ebit": [], "nopat": [],
                "capex": [], "nwc_change": [], "fcf": []}
        for i in range(yrs):
            rev = prev_rev * (1 + self.assumptions["revenue_growth"][i])
            ebitda = rev * self.assumptions["ebitda_margin"][i]
            dep = rev * self.assumptions["capex_percent"][i]   # D&A ≈ capex
            ebit = ebitda - dep
            tax = ebit * self.assumptions["tax_rate"]
            nopat = ebit - tax
            capex = dep
            nwc = rev * self.assumptions["nwc_percent"][i]
            d_nwc = nwc - prev_nwc
            fcf = nopat + dep - capex - d_nwc

            proj["year"].append(i + 1)
            proj["revenue"].append(rev); proj["ebitda"].append(ebitda)
            proj["ebit"].append(ebit); proj["nopat"].append(nopat)
            proj["capex"].append(capex); proj["nwc_change"].append(d_nwc)
            proj["fcf"].append(fcf)
            prev_rev, prev_nwc = rev, nwc

        self.projections = proj
        return proj

    # -- valuation ----------------------------------------------------------
    def value(self, exit_multiple=None):
        yrs = self.assumptions["projection_years"]
        wacc = self.wacc
        pv_fcf = [fcf / (1 + wacc) ** (i + 1) for i, fcf in enumerate(self.projections["fcf"])]
        total_pv_fcf = sum(pv_fcf)

        if exit_multiple is None:
            tv = (self.projections["fcf"][-1] * (1 + self.assumptions["terminal_growth"])
                  / (wacc - self.assumptions["terminal_growth"]))
            method = "Gordon growth"
        else:
            tv = self.projections["ebitda"][-1] * exit_multiple
            method = "exit multiple"

        pv_tv = tv / (1 + wacc) ** yrs
        ev = total_pv_fcf + pv_tv
        self.valuation = {
            "pv_fcf": total_pv_fcf, "terminal_value": tv, "pv_terminal": pv_tv,
            "enterprise_value": ev, "terminal_percent": pv_tv / ev * 100,
            "method": method, "pv_fcf_detail": pv_fcf,
        }
        return self.valuation

    def equity(self, net_debt, cash, shares):
        ev = self.valuation["enterprise_value"]
        eq = ev - net_debt + cash
        self.valuation.update({
            "equity_value": eq, "net_debt": net_debt, "cash": cash,
            "shares": shares, "value_per_share": eq / shares,
        })
        return self.valuation


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
model = DCFEngine("NovaTech Systems")
model.set_historical(
    revenue=[820, 940, 1080, 1240, 1420],     # $M (2021-2025)
    ebitda=[150, 180, 218, 260, 308],         # $M
    capex=[45, 50, 55, 62, 70],               # $M
    nwc=[85, 96, 110, 125, 142],              # $M
    years=[2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025],
)
model.set_assumptions(
    projection_years=5,
    revenue_growth=[0.16, 0.14, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08],
    ebitda_margin=[0.22, 0.23, 0.24, 0.25, 0.26],
    tax_rate=0.25,
    capex_percent=[0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05],
    nwc_percent=[0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10],
    terminal_growth=0.03,
)
model.calc_wacc(risk_free_rate=0.042, beta=1.25, market_premium=0.055,
                cost_of_debt=0.045, debt_to_equity=0.30)
model.project()
model.value()
model.equity(net_debt=180, cash=45, shares=120)

OUT = []
def section(t): OUT.append("\n" + "=" * 66 + f"\n  {t}\n" + "=" * 66)
def line(t=""): OUT.append(t)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
section("1. WACC BUILD-UP (Weighted Average Cost of Capital)")
w = model.wacc_components
for k, fmt in [("risk_free_rate", "Risk-free rate (10-yr Treasury):      {:6.2f}%"),
               ("beta", "Equity beta:                           {:6.2f}"),
               ("market_premium", "Equity market risk premium:              {:6.2f}%"),
               ("cost_of_equity", "Cost of equity (CAPM):                   {:6.2f}%"),
               ("cost_of_debt", "Pre-tax cost of debt:                    {:6.2f}%"),
               ("tax_rate", "Tax rate:                                {:6.2f}%"),
               ("debt_weight", "Debt weight:                             {:6.2f}%"),
               ("equity_weight", "Equity weight:                           {:6.2f}%")]:
    val = w[k] * 100 if k != "beta" else w[k]
    line(f"  {fmt.format(val)}")
line(f"  >> WACC = {w['wacc']*100:.2f}%")

section("2. 5-YEAR CASH FLOW PROJECTION ($M)")
p = model.projections
line(f"  {'Year':<6}{'Revenue':>10}{'EBITDA':>10}{'EBIT':>10}{'NOPAT':>10}{'Capex':>9}{'NWC Δ':>9}{'FCF':>10}")
